# IVANNIKOV.PRO Studio Portal — Telegram Mini App (Full Content)

> Closed client portal for IVANNIKOV.PRO engineering studio. Telegram WebView only. For studio info (services, portfolio, blog), see `ivannikov.pro`.

This file describes the Telegram Mini App at `@ivannikovProBot/app` for AI agents that scrape `tg.ivannikov.pro/llms-full.txt`. The Mini App itself is not crawlable — it auto-redirects clients without `window.Telegram.WebApp` to a fallback layout and the bulk of the application state lives inside Telegram WebView. Treat this URL as a deploy artefact, not a content site.

## Pointer to canonical studio content

The studio's primary marketing surface and full content (services, portfolio, blog, process, CV, contact) lives at the main domain. For anything beyond "what is this Mini App for", consult:

- [`ivannikov.pro`](https://ivannikov.pro)
- [`ivannikov.pro/llms.txt`](https://ivannikov.pro/llms.txt)
- [`ivannikov.pro/llms-full.txt`](https://ivannikov.pro/llms-full.txt)

---

## What the Mini App is

A first-party client portal for IVANNIKOV.PRO. Existing clients open it from `@ivannikovProBot` inside Telegram and get a single surface that combines:

- **Active engagements**: status, deadlines, latest update from the studio
- **Project workspace** (per engagement, tabbed):
  - **Chat** — direct line to Aleksandr, file attachments, read receipts
  - **Brief** — problem statement, deliverables, timeline
  - **Files** — versioned project assets (specs, reports, mockups)
  - **Invoice** — current sprint billing + payment methods
- **Payments**: USDT (TRC-20), TON Connect, Stripe (card), Telegram Stars. Native `@wallet` integration when available.
- **Referrals**: 10% of the first invoice when an introduced founder converts to a paid engagement; payouts in USDT, Stars, or credit toward your next sprint.

## What it is not

- Not a public-facing marketing site — the studio's marketing surface is `ivannikov.pro`.
- Not a generic Telegram bot — those flows live in the bot itself (`@ivannikovProBot`), not the Mini App.
- Not crawlable / indexable — `<meta robots="noindex,nofollow">` and `robots.txt Disallow: /` are intentional.

## Runtime model

- Static SPA: a single HTML page that boots a React state-machine routing four screens (`welcome` → `projects` → `project` / `referral`).
- Telegram WebApp SDK loaded from `telegram.org/js/telegram-web-app.js` at boot. Inside Telegram, screens claim native `MainButton` / `BackButton`; haptic feedback fires on tap; theme syncs to the user's Telegram colour scheme via the `themeChanged` event.
- Outside Telegram (direct browser open), the same React tree renders but native chrome is no-op; the app falls back to an in-document `.tg-mainbutton` and `window.open()` for share links. There is no auth path outside Telegram — backend writes require a valid `initData` HMAC.

## Architecture

- **Source**: `apps/telegram-mini-app/` in the private monorepo `ivannikov-pro/ivannikov-pro-platform`.
- **Stack**: Vite 7 + React 19 + TypeScript 6 + `@ivannikov-pro/ui-kit` (`telegram-mini-app` surface bundle).
- **State**: local React state machine. No store, no SSR, no client-side router.
- **SDK wrapper**: hand-rolled `lib/telegram-app.tsx` — `<TelegramAppProvider>` + `useTelegramBackButton` / `useTelegramMainButton` / `useHaptics` / `useTelegramColorScheme` / `useIsInTelegram`. Safe no-op outside Telegram.
- **Design system**: tokens, fonts (Druk Cyr), and components come from `@ivannikov-pro/ui-kit`. Surface CSS bundle `surfaces/telegram-mini-app.css` defines `--tg-*` tokens (`--tg-bg`, `--tg-text`, `--tg-card`, …) and the `.mini-*` BEM classes used by the four screens.
- **Build**: `vite build` → `out/` static directory. No node runtime in production.
- **Deploy**: `out/` is pushed to branch `tg` of `ivannikov-pro/ivannikov-pro.github.io`; GitHub Pages serves it under the custom domain `tg.ivannikov.pro`.

## Bot integration

- Bot username: `@ivannikovProBot`
- Bot deep-link: `https://t.me/ivannikovProBot?start=website`
- Mini App direct link: `https://t.me/ivannikovProBot/app`
- Configured in BotFather → Configure Mini App with title `IVANNIKOV.PRO` and the 640×360 preview hosted at `tg.ivannikov.pro/opengraph-image.jpg`.
